title: The Consensus Trap: Dissecting Subjectivity and the "Ground Truth" Illusion in Data Annotation
reasoning: The paper uses philosophical and ethical frameworks (procedural vs. outcome-oriented justice, 'niti' and 'nyaya', and epistemic justice) as its core analytical lens. It also explicitly examines faith-based (FRS) sensitivities and moral framing techniques in its review of data annotation practices.
